AGENDA
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  (STAFF ACCESS ONLY) MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E. Broadway,
  Room 105, Glendale, CA 91206

 Welcome to the meeting of the Planning Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6)
 and rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. Meetings are archived on
 the City Website for viewing anytime at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes-10259. If
 you have any question about matters on the agenda, or any requests for assistance, please contact the
 Community Development Department at (818) 548-2115 during regular business hours. All documents related
 to items on this agenda that are received prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available by
 contacting the Planning Division at 818-548-2115. The staff report and case materials will be available before
 the hearing date at www.glendaleca.gov/agendas.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language
 translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-
 day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign
 language translation and Braille transcription services.

  WEDNESDAY, MAY 6, 2020, AT 5:00 P.M.

Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from the
LA County Health Department, the Planning Commission hearing will be available to the public
electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is
encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
  On local cable TV: Charter Cable Channel 6.
  Streaming Online:
https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/management-services/gtv6/live-video-stream

For public comments and questions during the meeting, please call 818-937-8100.

City staff will be submitting the questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person during the
Planning Commission hearing.

  1.  ROLL CALL: Astorian, Chraghchian, Lee, Minassian, and Shahbazian

  2.  REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting was posted on Wednesday, April 29, 2020, on the Bulletin
  Board outside City Hall and on the City’s web site.

  3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
 AGENDA  2
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
Wednesday, May 6, 2020

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
   February 5, 2020 (Regular Meeting)

  5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is limited to 5
  minutes. The Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or
  decision.

  6.  ZONING APPEALS
  OLD BUSINESS: NONE.
  NEW BUSINESS: NONE.

  7. PLANNING COMMISSION ITEMS
  OLD BUSINESS

  (1) LOCATION:  520 NORTH CENTRAL AVENUE, and
  521 NORTH ORANGE STREET
   VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 82713
  (CONTINUED FROM FEBRUARY 5, AND 19; MARCH 4, AND 18;
  AND APRIL 1, AND 15, 2020)

  NOTE: THE APPLICANT HAS PROPOSED CHANGES TO THEIR VESTING TENTATIVE
  TRACT MAP APPLICATION. THIS ITEM WILL BE TAKEN OFF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION CALENDAR AND WILL BE RENOTICED TO ANOTHER PLANNING
  COMMISSION PUBLIC HEARING.

  NEW BUSINESS

  (1) LOCATION:  1212 VIOLA AVENUE
   TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 82878 (PTTMCP 1922954)
  (Continued From March 18, April 1, And 15, 2020)

  APPLICANT/OWNER:  Viola Partners, LLC

  ZONE:  “R-1250” - (High Density Residential)

  LEGAL DESCRIPTION: Lot 114 of Casa Verdugo Villa Tract, in the City of Glendale,
  County of Los Angeles, State of California, as per map
  recorded in Book 9, page 110 of Maps, in the office of the
  County Recorder of said County.

  CASE PLANNER:  Aileen Babakhani Planner

  PROJECT DESCRIPTION
  A tentative subdivision map has been filed showing a proposed development of land at
  1212 Viola Avenue for the purpose of creating a new 6-unit residential condominium
  project.
 AGENDA  3
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
Wednesday, May 6, 2020

  ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
  This project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 3 “New Construction or
  Conversion of Small Structures”, pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15303(b)
  because the development results in six or fewer units.

  REQUESTED ACTION
  The Community Development Department staff recommends that the Planning
  Commission approve Tentative Tract Map No. 82878 (PTTMCP 1922954), with findings
  and conditions as stated in the staff report dated March 18, 2020.

  (2) LOCATION:  361- 365 MYRTLE STREET
    TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 82266 (PTTMCP1919941),
  APPLICANT:  George Dagliyan
  OWNER:  George Dagliyan
  ZONE:  “R-1250” - (High Density Residential)
  LEGAL DESCRIPTION: Lots 36 & 38, Glendale Home Tract
  PROJECT DESCRIPTION
  A tentative subdivision map has been filed for a proposed development of land at 361 &
  365 Myrtle Street for the purpose of creating a new three-story, 12-unit multi-family
  residential condominium project.

  ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
  This project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 32- “In-fill Development Project”
  exemption pursuant to state CEQA Guidelines Section 15332 because the project
  meets all conditions for an in-fill development project.
  REQUESTED ACTION
  The Community Development Department staff recommends that the Planning
  Commission approve Tentative Tract Map No. 82266 (Case No. PTTMCP 1919941),
  with findings and conditions as stated in the staff report dated May 6, 2020.
